__about: Test set for the emergency fast-path (safety.py). Built from WHO IMCI general danger signs, Ghana Health Service maternal and newborn danger signs, and common community emergencies. 'urgent' messages MUST show the emergency card (target: 100%). 'routine' messages should not (target: 90% or more). Written by Claude for the prototype; a Ghanaian clinician should review and extend it, including Twi and Ewe phrasings, before the pilot.
